name: showAvatar
label: Show Avatar
description: Shows the user's avatar on the tile. If `showIcon` and `showAvatar` are both true then both will be displayed in the same area.

name: showIcon
label: Show Icon
description: Shows the provided icon for this tile. The property `icon` should be set if this property is true. If `showIcon` and `showAvatar` are both true then both will be displayed in the same area.

name: image
label: Image
description: A link to an image to be used in place of the user's avatar.

name: title
label: Title
description: The title text to be displayed in the main header area of the tile.

name: subTitle
label: Subtitle
description: The subtitle text to be displayed in the header below the main title text.

name: headerActions
label: Header Action Configuration List
description: An array of header actions objects. Each object should have three properties `icon`, `tooltipText`, and `variableName`. Payload is an object that will be appended to the seismic button click action when the header action button is clicked.

name: activated
label: Activated
description: Says if the tile is activated or not. An inactive tile will not have it's icon/avatar displayed and the actions will not be usable, but the data in the main body will still be displayed.

name: showTimeAgo
label: Show Timeago
description: Shows how long ago the tile was created in the header of the tile in a format according to the users system preferences.

name: icon
label: Icon Code
description: The icon code for this tile's icon. Should be set if showIcon is true.

name: iconColor
label: Icon Color Variant
description: The background color of this tile's icon.
